notes.title: 【FAQ】
notes.notes:
▼How do I play?
Fire arrows with left-click, collect meat with right-click.

▼How do I get drops?
The game has to be running in the background. You will receive your items automatically.

▼What is a Waifu Crystal?
It is used to claim a random item from the current drop pool. To convert 1 Crystal, click the following icon in-game:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e1n8vCD.png[/img]

▼What are coins?
Coins are used for redeeming prizes when there is an active [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3109050/view/536605983645896461]Loot Event[/url]

▼It's been over 2 hours and I'm not receiving anything.
Try reinstalling the game. You can have up to 8 crystals every 24 hours.

▼How do I save PC resources while idling?
Press '1' to change the FPS to 1.

▼How do I stack crystals?
[previewyoutube=Ux_g_fOy9L0;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3109050/eventcomments/4845401230255235518?snr=1_2108_9__2107
󠛡


▼What is a "Season"?
This is the main event where a set amount of Waifus will be available in the drop pool for all players to acquire. Once a season ends, all items from that period will stop dropping; an announcement will be made for when the next Season will arrive.

▼What's the probability of receiving "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/market/search?q=&category_3109050_category%5B%5D=tag_ssr&appid=3109050]SSR[/url]"?
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3109050/view/4335362463043756717]Season 1[/url] → 0.1%
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3109050/view/4580811814098376887]Season 2[/url] → 0.05%
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3109050/view/4442331835939160533]Season 3[/url] → 0.03%
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3109050/view/501689772772688518]Season 4[/url] → 0.01%

▼I'm unable to open the game because of my graphics card.
Add the following on your launch options: --rendering-driver opengl3

▼How do upgrades function?
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1RmuZ59.png[/img] Health Boost — +100 max health.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UwOs6jE.png[/img] Pocket Lunch — meat heals you above your max health.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/I85dq8s.png[/img] Meat Magnet — collect meats automatically.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vqmrUX0.png[/img] Guardian — freezes enemies.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aRCiCCm.png[/img] Fear Bird — scares away enemies.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1mhLojz.png[/img] Speed Up — increases arrow firing speed.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bwa60a9.png[/img] Strength Up — basic arrows deal double damage.
Spike Trap — deals damage to enemies except ghosts and flying units.
